fix: Do not copy the whole path during every Icon build. Either (a) put the canvas mapping (translation + uniform scale) on PathView as a transform field that the shape painter applies, so `From<Icon>` passes `value.path.clone()` (an Arc clone) and only sets that transform; or (b) memoize the transformed Arc<Path> keyed by (path pointer, view_box, size) so repeated builds reuse it. Option (a) keeps PathId stable for the source path.
